name: Hong Xiuquan
contribution: A Chinese revolutionary and religious leader who led the Taiping Rebellion against the Qing dynasty.

checks.lead: Hong Xiuquan (1 January 1814 – 1 June 1864), born Hong Huoxiu and with the courtesy name Renkun, was a Chinese revolutionary and religious leader who led the Taiping Rebellion against the Qing dynasty. He established the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom over large portions of southern China, with himself as its "Heavenly King".
